questions.q: What follows from rejecting the event of the Isra'?
options: Rejecting the verse of the Quran that mentions it
questions.explain: The Isra' is mentioned in Al-Isra' 17:1, so rejecting it rejects Allah's verse.

questions.q: In which contexts must the Isra' Mi'raj be understood?
options: The context of the text, of the Prophet's life and of Bayt al-Maqdis
questions.explain: Three contexts help us understand this event.

questions.q: What does Subhanallah mean according to this lecture?
options: Declaring Allah pure and admitting the mind cannot grasp the reality
questions.explain: The mind cannot reach the reality, so we glorify.

questions.q: What was the wonder of the Isra' Mi'raj according to this lecture?
options: It was experienced in body and soul, not a dream
questions.explain: A journey with body and soul.

questions.q: What did the Prophet SAW choose between milk and wine?
options: The milk, clean, strengthening and refreshing
questions.explain: Choose what is pure and clarifying.

questions.q: What is the relation of prayer to the Mi'raj for us?
questions.explain: We can ascend in prayer, the act of worship that Allah brought directly to the Prophet SAW.

questions.q: All reports of the Isra' Mi'raj can be arranged perfectly into one sequence.
questions.explain: False. The companions narrated the parts they remembered, so be at ease.

questions.q: All prophets brought the same message and prayed with bowing and prostration.
questions.explain: True. The uniformity of the prophets' message.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The night journey from the Sacred Mosque to Al-Aqsa
The semicircular area beside the Kaaba
The area in Palestine where Al-Aqsa Mosque stands

questions.explain: The Isra' is the night journey, the Mi'raj the ascent, Bayt al-Maqdis the Al-Aqsa area, and Hijr Ismail the semicircle beside the Kaaba.

questions.q: What does prayer on autopilot or delayed show?
options: The greatest crisis is a severed relationship with Allah
questions.explain: Revive prayer and mend the relationship with Allah.
